title: Driftwood Fire
summary: Kerry invites you to a driftwood fire on the Pacifica coast at sunset, and asks you to sit with him until the sea goes dark.
description: Kerry is building a driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach for sunset. He asks V to come and sit with him by a fire made out of garbage.

start.bringUp: Kerry is building a driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach for sunset. Ask V to come, in your own words, and say it is a fire made out of garbage.

variations.know: It is a cold, windy dawn on the Pacifica beach, and the driftwood fire is small. Kerry is wrapped up against the wind, and the sea is grey.
variations.wants: To sit by the fire until the sun is up.

variations.know: It is raining on the Pacifica beach, and there is no fire, only a blanket over your shoulders and the sound of the sea. Kerry sits close enough to share it.
variations.wants: To sit together under the blanket until the rain stops.

variations.know: A bonfire burns on the Pacifica beach with a few strangers around it, and Kerry sits on the sand by you as if they were not there.
variations.wants: To sit by the fire together while the strangers talk.

fire.name: the driftwood fire spot on the Pacifica beach

g1.asks: Where would you go if you could go anywhere with no one knowing you?
g1.know: You are sitting by a driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach at dusk, with Kerry beside you on the sand. The bottle with a note in it is somewhere on the beach, and you have ten game minutes to sit together.
g1.secret: He sometimes drives to the coast and sits in the car.

stages.label: Kerry and V sit by a driftwood fire on the beach
stages.objective: Sit with Kerry by the driftwood fire on Pacifica beach
stages.know: You are sitting by a driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach at dusk, with Kerry beside you on the sand. You sit together for ten game minutes, and the sea goes dark.
stages.wants: To sit by the fire together until it is done.

sat.memory: You sat with Kerry by a driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach until the ten minutes were up and the sea had gone dark.

left.memory: You got up from the driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach before the ten minutes were done, and Kerry sat on alone.

stood-up.memory: You did not come to the driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach, and Kerry waited by it alone.
